findings.message: The AudioSpecificConfig signals no SBR, but 12 of 12 raw data blocks hold SBR data, and 12 carry the parametric stereo extension: the stream is HE-AAC v2, signaled only implicitly, with an output rate of 44100 Hz. Decoders without SBR play the AAC LC core at 22050 Hz.
12 raw data blocks hold parametric stereo phase differences with enable_iid 0, which 8.4.2 does not allow (their number follows the intensity differences' mode); the first at 0x2DC.
